SPECIES WP 3 project update.docx

Complete source text from the project’s supplied research materials.

Download DOCX ↓View Drive source ↗

As part of the activities in SPECIES WP 3, Ben Dupuis visited a colleague at the University of Winnipeg (Canada). This colleague developed a model simulating the response of muskox population to climate change a few years ago. Together, we worked on the theoretical and practical implications of expanding this simulation to take into account the cost and benefits encountered by muskox when moving in an Arctic landscape (see conceptual picture below). This represents a critical step in our attempt to consider hunting pressure in the model we develop. Ultimately, our model will be able to simulate muskox moving and foraging in an Arctic landscape in responses to changes in snow cover or hunting events (informed through our collaboration with Astrid).
